annotations.title: Write to Fordeal about cooperation (partners, media, creators)

description: The cooperation forms (docs/texty/formulare.md 2–4) without the website. `kind` partner (an affiliate network, a feed provider or a technical integration: organization, website, markets as ISO codes, cooperation_type affiliate | feed | integration | other, message = the offer and its terms), media (name, organization = the newsroom, message = the topic or the information needed, optional deadline YYYY-MM-DD and links) or creator (name or channel, website = the main channel, topic = the content's topic and audience, message = the idea, optional links: other channels, media kit). A shop that wants to be compared uses register_shop instead. A person reads every message; the sender gets a confirmation of receipt (not an approval) and the operator one notice. The same message twice within a day answers the first id with duplicate true. Public, no key; five messages a minute per caller. 503 not_available until migration 0065 is applied.

cooperation_type.description: What a partner offers (required for a partner).

deadline.description: The day the media need an answer by (YYYY-MM-DD).

email.description: Where the confirmation and the answer go; never shown.

ip_hash.description: sha-256 of the sender's address with a daily salt (the website computes it); counts the per-visitor limit. Never stored as an address.

links.description: Documentation, a feed, the article, other channels or a media kit (links as text).

locale.description: Language of the confirmation (cs, sk, en; others get English).

markets.description: Markets the offer is about, ISO codes (partner, required): an array or a comma-separated string.

message.description: The offer and its terms (partner), the topic or the information needed (media), the idea (creator).

name.description: The contact person (partner, media) or the name of the channel (creator).

nickname.description: Leave empty (spam trap: a filled value is discarded quietly).

organization.description: The company or network (partner, required), the newsroom or medium (media, required).

topic.description: The creator's topic and audience (required for a creator).

website.description: The partner's website or the creator's main channel (required for both).
